Lindenmoor: 2,151,400 cubic metres = 2,151,400,000 litres.  
Kelmarsh: 1,739 megalitres = 1,739,000,000 litres.

Lindenmoor: 2,151,400,000 ÷ 29,051 ÷ 365 = 202.9 litres per resident per day.  
Kelmarsh: 1,739,000,000 ÷ 24,117 ÷ 365 = 197.6 litres per resident per day.

Difference: 5.3 litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.3 litres per resident per day
